note: A material that can undergo nuclear fission or fusion to release energy; in commercial reactors, usually uranium fuel.

senses.m: A material that can undergo nuclear fission or fusion to release energy
senses.pat: nuclear-fuel cycle · nuclear fuel rods · dispose of nuclear fuel
ex: The reactor uses uranium as nuclear fuel.
Lò phản ứng sử dụng uranium làm nhiên liệu hạt nhân.
Spent nuclear fuel is stored under strict safety controls.
Nhiên liệu hạt nhân đã qua sử dụng được lưu giữ theo các biện pháp an toàn nghiêm ngặt.

note: A plate displaying a vehicle registration number; British English. US English says license plate or license tag.

senses.m: A plate displaying a vehicle registration number
senses.pat: read a number plate · front/rear number plate · number-plate recognition
ex: The camera captured the car’s number plate.
Camera ghi lại biển số của chiếc xe.
The replacement number plate must meet legal standards.
Biển số thay thế phải đáp ứng tiêu chuẩn pháp luật.

note: Machine-readable instructions produced by compiling source code; exact format depends on processor and system.

senses.m: Machine-readable instructions produced by compiling source code
senses.pat: compile into object code · object-code file · link object code
ex: The compiler translated the program into object code.
Trình biên dịch chuyển chương trình thành mã đối tượng.
The linker combined the object-code files.
Trình liên kết kết hợp các tệp mã đối tượng.

note: A man paid to do small, varied tasks or repairs; old-fashioned and gendered. Odd-job worker or handyman is more neutral.

senses.m: A man paid to do small, varied tasks or repairs
senses.pat: hire an odd-job man · work as an odd-job man · odd-job services
ex: They hired an odd-job man to repair the fence.
Họ thuê một thợ sửa việc vặt để sửa hàng rào.
The building manager arranged for an odd-job worker to fix the door.
Quản lý tòa nhà sắp xếp thợ sửa việc vặt đến sửa cửa.

note: Small miscellaneous items or tasks, often left over; informal plural expression.

senses.m: Small miscellaneous items or tasks, often left over
senses.pat: a box of odds and ends · finish a few odds and ends · household odds and ends
ex: The drawer was full of odds and ends.
Ngăn kéo đầy những món đồ lặt vặt.
I need to finish a few odds and ends before leaving.
Tôi cần hoàn thành vài việc lặt vặt trước khi đi.

note: A US federal executive-branch office that assists the president with budget preparation and federal agency management; commonly abbreviated OMB.

senses.m: A US federal executive-branch office that assists the president with budget preparation and federal agency management
senses.pat: the Office of Management and Budget · OMB review · submit a budget to OMB
ex: The Office of Management and Budget reviewed the proposal.
Văn phòng Quản lý và Ngân sách xem xét đề xuất.
OMB coordinates the federal budget process.
OMB điều phối quy trình ngân sách liên bang.

note: Paint made with pigment bound in oil; British English. US spelling is oil color, and the medium is commonly called oil paint.

senses.m: Paint made with pigment bound in oil
senses.pat: paint in oil colour · oil-colour portrait · oil colours on canvas
ex: The artist used oil colour to create a layered portrait.
Họa sĩ dùng sơn dầu để tạo bức chân dung nhiều lớp.
The gallery displayed oil colours on canvas.
Phòng tranh trưng bày các tác phẩm sơn dầu trên vải.

note: A lamp that burns liquid oil, historically used before widespread electric lighting and still used where electricity is unavailable.

senses.m: A lamp that burns liquid oil, historically used before widespread electric lighting and still used where electricity is unavailable
senses.pat: light an oil lamp · fill the oil lamp · an antique oil lamp
ex: They lit an oil lamp during the power cut.
Họ thắp đèn dầu khi mất điện.
The museum keeps the oil lamp behind glass.
Bảo tàng trưng bày chiếc đèn dầu sau lớp kính.

note: A nickname for the flag of the United States, especially in patriotic contexts; capitalize as a proper nickname.

senses.m: A nickname for the flag of the United States, especially in patriotic contexts
senses.pat: fly/display Old Glory · Old Glory waves · salute Old Glory
ex: Old Glory flew above the town hall.
Quốc kỳ Hoa Kỳ tung bay phía trên tòa thị chính.
The ceremony began with a salute to Old Glory.
Buổi lễ bắt đầu bằng nghi thức chào quốc kỳ Hoa Kỳ.

note: A sandwich made with toppings on one slice of bread rather than enclosed between slices; also called an open-faced sandwich.

senses.m: A sandwich made with toppings on one slice of bread rather than enclosed between slices
senses.pat: make an open sandwich · an open sandwich with salmon · serve open sandwiches
ex: She ordered an open sandwich with smoked salmon.
Cô gọi bánh mì mở mặt với cá hồi hun khói.
The café serves open sandwiches on rye bread.
Quán phục vụ bánh mì mở mặt trên bánh mì lúa mạch đen.

note: Software whose source code is made available under a license allowing use, inspection, modification, and redistribution under specified terms; also used for open-source projects.

senses.m: Software whose source code is made available under a license allowing use, inspection, modification, and redistribution under specified terms
senses.pat: open-source software · an open-source license · release code as open source
ex: The team released the tool as open-source software.
Nhóm phát hành công cụ dưới dạng phần mềm mã nguồn mở.
Check the open-source license before reusing the code.
Hãy kiểm tra giấy phép mã nguồn mở trước khi tái sử dụng mã.

note: A policy of being accessible or welcoming to people who want to discuss concerns; also a historical term for equal access to trade or immigration, depending on context.

senses.m: A policy of being accessible or welcoming to people who want to discuss concerns
senses.pat: have an open-door policy · an open-door policy on trade · open-door access
ex: The manager has an open-door policy for staff concerns.
Người quản lý luôn sẵn sàng lắng nghe những băn khoăn của nhân viên.
The treaty proposed an open-door policy for trade.
Hiệp ước đề xuất chính sách mở cửa thương mại.

note: Small binoculars, often decorative, used to view a stage from a distance; singular opera glass is less common.

senses.m: Small binoculars, often decorative, used to view a stage from a distance
senses.pat: a pair of opera glasses · look through opera glasses · opera-glass handle
ex: She raised her opera glasses to see the stage.
Cô đưa ống nhòm opera lên để nhìn sân khấu.
The antique opera glasses had a mother-of-pearl handle.
Chiếc ống nhòm opera cổ có tay cầm khảm xà cừ.

note: A theater designed or used for opera performances; some venues also host ballet and concerts.

senses.m: A theater designed or used for opera performances
senses.pat: perform at an opera house · a historic opera house · opera-house stage
ex: The company performed at the city’s opera house.
Đoàn biểu diễn tại nhà hát opera của thành phố.
The opera house reopened after a major renovation.
Nhà hát opera mở cửa lại sau đợt cải tạo lớn.

note: A table on which a patient lies during surgery.

senses.m: A table on which a patient lies during surgery
senses.pat: lie on the operating table · prepare the operating table · operating-table equipment
ex: The surgical team prepared the operating table.
Đội phẫu thuật chuẩn bị bàn mổ.
The patient was moved onto the operating table.
Bệnh nhân được chuyển lên bàn mổ.

note: A goal scored accidentally against one’s own team in soccer; figuratively, an action that harms one’s own interests.

senses.m: A goal scored accidentally against one’s own team in soccer
senses.pat: score an own goal · an embarrassing own goal · make an own goal
ex: The defender accidentally scored an own goal.
Hậu vệ vô tình đá phản lưới nhà.
The policy became an own goal for the campaign.
Chính sách đó trở thành đòn tự gây bất lợi cho chiến dịch.

note: The largest ocean, between Asia and Australia to the west and the Americas to the east; capitalize the proper name.

senses.m: The largest ocean, between Asia and Australia to the west and the Americas to the east
senses.pat: across the Pacific Ocean · Pacific Ocean islands · Pacific Ocean currents
ex: The ship sailed across the Pacific Ocean.
Con tàu vượt Thái Bình Dương.
The storm strengthened over the western Pacific Ocean.
Cơn bão mạnh lên trên vùng tây Thái Bình Dương.

note: A strong box or crate used to pack and transport goods; British English.

senses.m: A strong box or crate used to pack and transport goods
senses.pat: put goods in a packing case · wooden packing case · seal a packing case
ex: The sculptures were placed in a wooden packing case.
Các tác phẩm điêu khắc được đặt trong một thùng gỗ đóng hàng.
The packing case was marked fragile.
Thùng đóng hàng được đánh dấu dễ vỡ.

note: To persuade someone to accept something inferior, unwanted, or misrepresented; often palm something off on someone.

senses.m: To persuade someone to accept something inferior, unwanted, or misrepresented
senses.pat: palm off a fake · palm something off on a customer · be palmed off with
ex: The seller tried to palm off a damaged phone as new.
Người bán cố đánh tráo chiếc điện thoại hỏng thành hàng mới.
They palmed off the extra work on an inexperienced assistant.
Họ đẩy thêm việc cho một trợ lý thiếu kinh nghiệm.

note: An edible vegetable oil from the fruit of oil palms; production can raise environmental and labor concerns, which vary by source and certification.

senses.m: An edible vegetable oil from the fruit of oil palms
senses.pat: palm-oil production · palm oil industry · palm-oil-free product
ex: The label lists palm oil among the ingredients.
Nhãn ghi dầu cọ trong thành phần.
The company says its palm oil is certified sustainable.
Công ty cho biết dầu cọ của họ được chứng nhận bền vững.
